title: INCOMING FAX
body:
INCOMING FAX – INTERNAL USE ONLY

BORDER COMMUNICATIONS STATION – SECTOR 3

PERSONNEL ARRIVAL CONFIRMATION

Operator {PLAYER_NAME},

The Central Administration has registered the activation of your assigned station.

Your arrival has been confirmed.

We trust that your previous experience in civilian radio communications will prove valuable in fulfilling your new responsibilities.

As you have been informed, the National Border Communications Network is currently operating with limited qualified personnel.

Your cooperation is therefore essential.

From this moment forward, all transmissions, border authorizations, and operational incidents occurring at this station are your responsibility.

Your performance will be reviewed regularly.

Any errors or irregularities will be documented and forwarded to the appropriate authorities.

We expect the same level of competence demonstrated in your previous employment.

Your first assignment will follow shortly.

Serve with discipline. Maintain order.

CIVIL HARMONY
